people.name: Tamar
people.line: David's daughter, raped by her half-brother Amnon

translations.web: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head, and went her way, crying aloud as she went.
translations.bsb: And Tamar put ashes on her head and tore her robe. And putting her hand on her head, she went away crying aloud.
translations.kjv: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.
translations.asv: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head, and went her way, crying aloud as she went.
